rounds.text: The valuation of iStreet Network Ltd is severely disconnected from its intrinsic cash generation capabilities, trading at an elevated P/E of 64.3x and a P/B of 6.83x [E1, E2], which heavily outpaces sector benchmarks of 20.77x and 4.03x respectively [E6, E7]. A discounted cash flow model explicitly flags the stock as overvalued with an intrinsic value of Rs 29 per share against a market price of Rs 45.1, leaving a negative margin of safety of -57.9% [E38, E39]. Furthermore, operating cash flow collapsed to Rs -35.22 Cr alongside a free cash flow of Rs -41.89 Cr in Mar 2026, delivering a disastrous cash conversion ratio of -7.10x [E29, E30, E31]. Operational execution is also deteriorating, marked by declining quarterly operating margins dropping to 2% in Mar 2026 [E26], ballooning working capital days extending from 77.8 to 143 days [E58], and high debtors stretching to 365 days [E57]. Conceded: [E14], [E18], [E22].
